then.text: Enjoy the view from the roof. On a clear day you can see the cathedral, the university and three people arguing about parking.

else.text: For the Becket exhibition? Here: a pilgrim badge, found in the Stour in the 1980s. A tiny tin Becket's head in a mitre, with a pin on the back for your hat.
Pilgrims bought them by the thousand. They were the medieval fridge magnet.
This was the city gaol for centuries, right up to the 1820s and beyond. The cells are still here. The prisoners weren't keen on the view.
The gun ports on the towers are some of the earliest built for cannon in England. Very modern. For 1380.
